$comment: How long a newer major may sit above a pin before check:ci-pin-freshness turns red, in DAYS, counted from the first release on that major line (operator ruling 2026-10-14T20:56Z).

Under the grace a newer major is printed and passes; at or past it the gate is red until the pin is bumped with `npm run pins -- bump <id> --major --reason "<why>"` or held with an expiry through `npm run pins -- hold <id> --reason "<why>" --expires YYYY-MM-DD`.
A major whose first release cannot be dated is red at once (fail closed).

Read by scripts/lib/pins/status.ts getMajorGraceMs, which throws on a missing file or key rather than reading it as zero. The release-age window beside it (.ci/config/release-age.json) is a different rule: it holds a too-new release back, this one stops an old major from waiting forever.
